1.w: And in the year of the death of King Uzziah, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne being high and lifted up, and his train was filling the temple.

2.w: Seraphim stood above Him, [with] six wings for each—six wings—with two he covered his face, and with two he covered his feet, and with two he flew.

3.w: And this one cried to this one and said: “Holy, holy, holy [is] YHWH of Hosts; the fullness of all the earth [is] His glory!”

4.w: And the posts of the doors were shaken from the voice of the one calling, and the house was filled with smoke.

5.w: And I said, “Woe to me, for I am finished! For I [am] a man of unclean lips, and I am dwelling in the midst of a people of unclean lips; for the King YHWH of Hosts, my eyes have seen!”

6.w: And flew to me one from the seraphim, and in his hand [was] a hot coal he had taken from the altar with tongs.

7.w: And he touched [it] upon my mouth and said, “Behold, this has touched upon your lips; and is turned aside your iniquity, and your sin is wiped away.”

8.w: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, “Whom will I send, and who will go for Us?” And I said “Here [am] I—send me!”

9.w: And He said, “Go and say to the people this: ‘Be ever hearing and never understanding, and be ever seeing and never knowing.’

10.w: Fatten the heart of this people, and its ears make heavy and its eyes shut, lest it see with its eyes, hear and with its ears, and understand [with] its heart, and turn back and there be healing for it.

11.w: And I said, “Until when, O Lord?” And He answered, “Until when the cities lie in ruins without one dwelling, and the houses without man, and the land lies in ruins [as] a desolation,

12.w: and YHWH has removed man far away, and [are] many the forsaken places in the midst of the land.

13.w: And still [are] in it a tenth, and will it return and be for burning, like the terebinth and oak that in falling [is] a stump in them. The seed of holiness [is] its stump.”
